# ProjectionHub

> ProjectionHub provides CPA-prepared financial projection templates, custom financial modeling services, and business planning tools designed to help small businesses and advisors create investor-ready financial forecasts and secure SBA funding.

ProjectionHub specializes in Excel-based financial projection templates across 100+ industries, complemented by professional consulting services including custom financial modeling, business plan writing, and SBA loan preparation assistance. The platform serves both individual entrepreneurs and financial advisors through its ProjectionHub+ subscription offering.

## Financial Projection Templates & Tools

- [Financial Projection Templates](https://www.projectionhub.com/financial-projection-excel-templates): Library of 100+ CPA-prepared Excel financial projection templates by industry.
- [Existing Business Financial Projection Template](https://www.projectionhub.com/financial-projection-template/existing-business): Financial projection template for established businesses with 5-year forecasts.
- [Acquisition Financial Projection Template](https://www.projectionhub.com/financial-projection-template/acquisition): Acquisition-focused financial projection template for 5-year pro forma statements.
- [Coffee Shop Financial Projection Template](https://www.projectionhub.com/financial-projection-template/coffee-shop): Industry-specific financial projection template for coffee shop businesses.
- [Free Business Valuation Calculator](https://www.projectionhub.com/resources/valuation-calculator): Free business valuation calculator tool for determining realistic business worth.
